title: Acceptance from a reachable accepting code
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine deciding a language $L$ in space $sp$, and let $x$ be a bit string. If some natural number $t$ is reachable from the initial configuration code by zero or more valid steps within a fixed work-tape window and encodes an accepting configuration in that window, then $x\in L$.
hypotheses_covered: There exists a natural number $t$ reachable from the initial code by zero or more valid steps within the window
$t$ encodes an accepting configuration within the window
